summary.text: Alexander Mendez is an unenrolled candidate for the Massachusetts State Senate, Norfolk and Plymouth District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mendez previously ran as an independent candidate for the same seat in 2016, 2018 and 2020, losing each general election to incumbent Democrat John Keenan.
In 2020, Keenan won 69.2 percent of the vote to Mendez's 30.4 percent.
